# Yoosuf Mohamed

> Systems Architect helping startups and enterprises build AI automation and AI-first products that scale. Specialises in LLM, RAG, Go, Elixir, FastAPI, Node, NestJS, NextJS, ReactJS, Flutter, AWS, and systems architecture. Based in Colombo, Sri Lanka with over a decade of experience.

## Pages

- [Home](https://yoosuf.me/): Personal site — AI automation, systems architecture, and AI-first products
- [About](https://yoosuf.me/about/): Background, skills, and architectural philosophy
- [Services](https://yoosuf.me/services/): Engagement models and starting prices — architecture consulting, performance audits, AI integration, product development, and fractional tech leadership
- [Terms & Payments](https://yoosuf.me/terms-payments/): Full details on pricing, quotes, deposits, milestone payments, invoicing, taxes, refunds, and termination
- [Blog](https://yoosuf.me/blog/): Articles on AI, systems architecture, software engineering, and personal topics
- [Contact](https://yoosuf.me/contact/): Ways to get in touch or book an appointment
